workload.name: Cache impact: cold vs warm Rust build (experiment)
workload.description: Pairs of jobs per runner on aome510/spotify-player (same phases as the rust suite). Cold: restores a cache key no job used before (run id, attempt, runner), so it must miss; checks no target dir exists; builds; saves ~/.cargo/registry, ~/.cargo/git/db and target with the provider's cache path (actions/cache, rerouted by RunsOn s3-cache, Blacksmith, Ubicloud, Avrea; WarpBuilds/cache on WarpBuild). Warm: a fresh runner restores exactly that key and rebuilds. A probe records every transparent cache the runner applies without being asked (cargo source replacement, npm registry, apt proxy, sccache variables, Docker mirrors and builders). metrics.cachewarm counts the crates each phase compiled.
